posts.description: Hey, glad to see you here. My name is Prerit. You’ll find me at Studio RTF , at Bessemer Venture Partners , or ranting in Return the Fund . Currently, my focus is on the intersection of data infra, agents, and UX in a post-app world. To that end, my latest project is Text Maddie . I'm always looking for collabs and co-conspirators. Beyond these endeavors, I'm an obsessive piano player and drummer,
